title: Filolial Race
paragraphs: The venue, to put it simply, is a dome-shaped building with an atmosphere similar to a sports stadium. I’m reminded of the times I used to enjoy various sports like baseball, soccer, and basketball with the pigs who had different hobbies back then. This place brings back memories of those venues.

However, the crowd here has a rather intense atmosphere. I never went to a horse racing track before. Ah, but this feels a bit like a cycling race. I’ve been to one of those. One of the pigs had a hobby of that sort.
“The race is about to begin!”
Without buying any tickets, we watched the situation unfold from the spectator stands. The Filolials were being led around and shown off. If I recall correctly, this part is called the paddock.
“Hmm… they seem a little too excited. I wonder how that will affect the race…”

I can hear the commentator’s voice coming through the speakers. Judging from the tension and the condition of their bodies, I feel like numbers 3 and 6 will be the top contenders. By the way, I know that there are different types of Filolial races. This time, it seems to be a simple circuit race with jockeys riding on top. I’d also like to see an obstacle race someday.
“Wow, this is so exciting and fun!”
Kou’s eyes sparkled as he looked around. His body was fidgeting restlessly. He’s definitely being affected by the atmosphere of the venue. This is part of the thrill of the Filolial races.
“I’m curious to see what kind of contestants will be running.”

Yuki-chan was staring intently at the course. She didn’t seem interested in anything else. Indeed, Yuki-chan is a Filolial who is more focused on running. In fact, when it comes to pulling carriages, her interest is lower compared to other Filolials. Of course, since she’s a Filolial, it’s not that she dislikes pulling carriages. On the contrary, Sakura-chan, much like Filo-tan, enjoys pulling carriages. Apparently, this is a characteristic of the Filorialia species. A trumpet-like instrument sounded, and the Filolials entered the gates all at once. The gates closed. As soon as the flag was lowered, the doors of the gates flew open, and the Filolials dashed out, running at full speed.
“Oh…”
What an emotional sight. The Filolials are giving it their all, racing to be number one.
“…They’re a little slow, aren’t they?”
Yuki-chan seemed to be analyzing the situation.
“At that speed, Sakura would be faster… But if I’m going to enter, I’ll aim for first place!”

Yuki-chan’s rival is Sakura-chan. Sakura-chan is laid-back and rarely runs, but she’s fast enough to compete with Yuki-chan. That’s why Yuki-chan often asks Sakura-chan to race with her. As I predicted, the results were 3 and 6.
“What an enjoyable race!”
“The pacing, the way they run, the differences from pulling a carriage… There’s a lot to learn!”

According to Yuki-chan, there were many things to learn, like managing pace and performing steps she usually wouldn’t use while running. Just for that alone, it was worth coming here. That day, we watched race after race with intense focus. By the time evening came, I returned to the inn.
“Oh, welcome back, Motoyasu. How was it?”
“It was a very worthwhile race.”
“That’s great. I managed to learn the Meteor Shield.”
“This will make battles much easier.”
“Yeah. Based on my tests, it’s easy to use and quite convenient.”
Oh, it seems that even Father has mastered the traditional Meteor Shield. With the races included, today was an amazing day.
“Motoyasu, have you already eaten?”
“Not yet.”
“I’m hungry.”
“Yuki-chan, the breeder told you to watch your weight, though…”
“I can diet for the sake of the race!”
“Well, if there’s any issue, I can use magic to adjust the weight a little… I guess?”
“I want to do this fair and square!”

It seems there are quite a few complicated circumstances involved with Filolial races. I’ll have to get the details from the breeder later! It’s such a fun place that it could become a lifelong passion.
“We were thinking of grabbing a bite to eat somewhere. Want to come, Motoyasu?”
“Of course!”
“Then let’s wait for Ren and Itsuki to get back before we go.”
“Understood!”
By the way, it seems that Ren, Itsuki, and Éclair went to watch the colosseum. Maybe we should go check it out later? Just as I was thinking that, Ren and the others returned.
“We’re back.”
“Oh, Itsuki, Ren, and Éclair. How was the colosseum?”
“The duels between the mercenaries… It was quite an intense spectacle. It felt like watching a movie.”
“Yeah, just observing their techniques was interesting.”
Ren nodded in agreement with Itsuki.
“I’ve heard that mercenary martial arts tend to be rather crude, but that was an efficient fighting style in its own way. There’s a lot to learn from it.”
Éclair already has plenty of skill. Hearing about the style that makes use of energy boosts, it seems she’s working hard to master it.
“So, does everyone want to give it a try?”
“Itsuki would probably enter with a ring name like Perfect Hidden Justice!”
“What’s with that embarrassing name?!”
What do you mean? I heard that was the ring name Itsuki used in his original world. Well, I never actually saw it myself, though.
“That’s what Father mumbled when he was mocking Itsuki in the first world, right? Something about the name he used at the colosseum.”
“Naofumi-san!?”
“Huh? How is this my fault!?”
Father shook his head, as if to say it was unfair. That’s right. It was just the foolish Itsuki who brought this upon himself.
“You’re talking about the time when Itsuki was acting like a clown. He’s different now, don’t worry about it.”
“…Understood. But seriously, that name is way too on the nose… I don’t even know what I was thinking.”
“Maybe you were drowning in your sense of justice?”
“Maybe… But it’s scary because I can actually see myself doing it.”
“By the way, Naofumi, did you find any relatives of Imiya?”
At Ren’s words, Father shook his head.
“Not at all… Apparently, situations like hers are pretty common in Zeltoble, so I couldn’t even find a lead in a day.”
“Would it be best to ask the country to arrange for someone knowledgeable?”
“Maybe. But I’ll figure something out, so Imiya, just wait a little longer, okay?”
“Y-Yes…”
Mole looked down as Father reassured her. Don’t worry. If Father puts his mind to it, nothing is impossible.
“Heh, Imiya really trusts Iwatani-dono, doesn’t she?” Éclair murmured, looking pleased.
Mole lowered her head even more.
“Eclair-san, don’t tease Imiya.”
“It was just a joke. Sorry, Imiya. Well then, shall we go eat?”
“Yeah, let’s go try some of Zeltoble’s famous dishes.”

With that lively mood, we all stepped out into the night streets of Zeltoble. Even at night, Zeltoble was full of life, so it didn’t feel strange for all of us to be walking together. The city was so diverse and bustling that it felt like a melting pot of different races.
“Where should we go?”
“Wouldn’t a more common place be better? Maybe somewhere with drinks.”
“Underage.”
“Naofumi-san, you’re so strict.”
“Yeah, exactly.”
Ren voiced his objection. Is he that eager to drink?
“Naofumi-san, you don’t get drunk, right?”
“Yeah. That’s why I was often the organizer during drinking parties. Everyone ended up completely wasted most of the time.”
“I can see how that’s convenient, but it also sounds kind of sad.”
“That doesn’t mean I’m going to let you and Ren drink, though.”
“Nano! Gaelion wants to try alcohol. I heard that fine sake seeps into the body nicely, nano.”
When Rival said that, Father looked troubled and glanced toward Assistant.
“Dragons are heavy drinkers.”
“Hmm… But seeing you drink with that appearance is kind of…”
It’s easy to forget, but Rival is still in her young girl form, competing with Sakura-chan.
“Then I’ll transform into my dragon form later, nano!”
“What about Sakura?”
“Do Filolials even have a tendency to drink alcohol, Motoyasu?”
“I’ve never heard of such a thing.”
“Then it’s a no.”
“Alcohol?”
“Wait, you asked without knowing? Anyway, Sakura-chan, no drinking for you.”
“I hate that smell!”
Father almost stumbled. With a strained smile, Father said, “Then let’s have some fruit juice instead.” Hearing that, Sakura-chan was delighted.
